findings: The company reports offering high-purity bovine lactoferrin (Lactoferrin MIG-95® and Lactoferrin CLN™) in customizable powder physical formats, specifically available in both spray-dried and freeze-dried forms.

In a joint partnership with Colostrum BioTec GmbH, the company introduced a liquid lactoferrin ingredient format that is shelf-stable at room temperature, offered in 6 ml flavored shots and 125 ml consumer bottles as well as 20 liter pouches for industrial manufacturing.

The evaluation rests on the company's verified capabilities to produce high-purity bovine lactoferrin in multiple physical forms, including both spray-dried and freeze-dried powders, as well as a specialized shelf-stable liquid format available in varying packaging sizes for retail and industrial use.
